# go test -toolexec builds and runs the tests against the vectorized package.

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG=$WORK/log
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG_PKGS=example.com/app/vec
exec go test -toolexec=$LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC ./...
stdout -count=1 '^ok  	example\.com/app/vec	'
cmp log log.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27.1
-- vec/vec.go --
package vec

func AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- vec/vec_test.go --
package vec

import "testing"

func TestAddInt32s(t *testing.T) {
	dst := make([]int32, 37)
	a := make([]int32, 37)
	b := make([]int32, 37)
	for i := range a {
		a[i], b[i] = int32(i), int32(3*i)
	}
	AddInt32s(dst, a, b)
	for i := range dst {
		if dst[i] != int32(4*i) {
			t.Fatalf("dst[%d] = %d, want %d", i, dst[i], 4*i)
		}
	}
}
-- log.want --
rewrote 1 loop(s) in example.com/app/vec
